headlines.text: On a Wednesday in 2020, back when a new champion was crowned for the AEW Women's World Title as Nyla Rose vs. Riho battled it out, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.87 ? a good, competitive contest ? ending the champion's reign at 6 defenses.
